description: Suijin OS v5.7.0 — The Interactive Operator. File-based live guidance (the operator types, the AI reads, a green panel confirms delivery), the adaptive typewriter stream (60 micro-increment gears, light think / cyan speak, command boxes with syntax highlighting), the classed vulnerability system (agent-defined severity + CVSS, POC step-scripts the TERMINAL executes, three-choice abandon/edit/claim flow), per-engagement state scoping (state dies with the run), .sje engagement bundles (save on conclusion, resume with full memory), the interactive review rig (scripts/tui_drive.py — spawn under a real PTY, drive with raw keystrokes, reproduce bugs live), diagnostic logging (every LLM call, tool, node transition to outputs/logs/diag.log), and the always-at-the-bottom input box (mode cycling, Alt+I intelligence tiers, ESC ESC instant pause, /quit full-save). 1,867 tests green.
